notes.title: Caketomino Release
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Smoketree Studios would like to present our first VR game - Caketomino! We hope fans of both Pentomino puzzles and Tetris will enjoy our small game about making (and eating) cakes! 

We hope to continue making more games with what we've learned making Caketomino, so please stay tuned!

-Smoketree Studios
